html:
1What You Will Learn

  • Match the AI services to the task: text, speech, images, documents and conversation
  • Say what Amazon SageMaker AI is for, and place Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Q
  • Describe the analytics flow: Kinesis, Glue, Athena, Redshift, EMR, OpenSearch and Amazon Quick
  • Choose the right service from a short description of the need

2AI, ML and analytics services

Running case

Tidewater Has Data to Use

  • Tidewater has thousands of reviews, scanned supplier invoices and recorded support calls
  • It wants a chatbot for order questions, and product photos checked for unsafe content
  • Sales files in S3 need quick SQL answers, and the shop's clicks arrive as a live stream
  • Managers want dashboards, and the data team wants to train its own model
  • Your job: choose the AI, ML and analytics services

Task First, Then the Service

  • Pre-built AI services do one task through an API, with no machine learning expertise needed
  • Text: Amazon Comprehend and Amazon Translate
  • Speech: Amazon Transcribe and Amazon Polly
  • Images, video and documents: Amazon Rekognition and Amazon Textract
  • Conversation: Amazon Lex
  • Your own models: Amazon SageMaker AI

Exam tip: Name the input (text, speech, image, document or conversation) and the task.

Text and Documents: Comprehend, Translate and Textract

Service What it does Think
Amazon Comprehend Natural language processing: finds entities, key phrases, sentiment, language and personally identifiable information in text; custom classification What do customers feel?
Amazon Translate Text translation with machine learning, to build multilingual applications Translate it
Amazon Textract Detects typed and handwritten text and extracts forms and tables; has operations for invoices, receipts and IDs Read the scanned form

Exam tip: Sentiment in text: Comprehend. Text from scanned forms: Textract. Translation: Translate.

Speech, Images and Chat: Transcribe, Polly, Rekognition and Lex

Service What it does Think
Amazon Transcribe Speech to text: converts audio to text, streaming or batch from S3 Calls to text
Amazon Polly Text to speech: lifelike speech in many languages and voices Read it aloud
Amazon Rekognition Image and video analysis: detects objects, text, faces and unsafe content and compares faces What is in the picture?
Amazon Lex Builds chatbots for voice and text with speech recognition and language understanding A conversation

Exam tip: Speech to text: Transcribe. Text to speech: Polly. Pictures: Rekognition. Chatbots: Lex.

Build Your Own and Ask for Help: SageMaker AI, Bedrock and Amazon Q Old name [Verify live]

  • Amazon SageMaker AI is a fully managed ML service where data scientists and developers build, train and deploy their own models
  • Amazon SageMaker was renamed SageMaker AI on 3 December 2024; Amazon SageMaker now names a wider data, analytics and AI platform
  • Amazon Bedrock gives managed access to foundation models through one API for generative AI applications Beyond the guide
  • Amazon Q Developer is a generative AI assistant that helps you understand, build and operate AWS applications
  • As of 4 November 2026: Amazon Q Business is closed to new customers (AWS points to Amazon Quick), and Q Developer IDE plugins end on 30 April 2027

Exam tip: Build and train your own ML models: SageMaker AI.

From Data to Decisions: The Analytics Services Old name

  • Collect: Amazon Kinesis takes in streaming data, and Amazon S3 holds the data lake
  • Prepare: AWS Glue discovers, catalogs and transforms the data
  • Analyze: Athena, Redshift, EMR and OpenSearch Service answer different kinds of questions
  • Visualize: Amazon Quick builds dashboards; it evolved from Amazon QuickSight, which lives on as Amazon Quick Sight

Exam tip: Think collect, prepare, analyze, visualize; then pick the service for each stage.

Streaming and Preparing Data: Kinesis, Firehose and AWS Glue Old name

Service What it does Think
Amazon Kinesis Data Streams Collects and processes large streams of data records in real time; many applications can read one stream Real-time streams
Amazon Data Firehose Delivers streaming data to S3, Redshift, OpenSearch Service and more, with no applications to write; earlier called Kinesis Data Firehose Load streams into stores
AWS Glue Serverless data integration: discovers, prepares, moves and integrates data; Data Catalog, crawlers, ETL (extract, transform and load) jobs; pay as you go Prepare and catalog
  • Kinesis also includes Video Streams and Managed Service for Apache Flink

Exam tip: Live stream: Kinesis. Deliver a stream to S3 or Redshift: Firehose. Catalog and ETL: Glue.

Querying and Big Data: Athena, Redshift, EMR and OpenSearch

Service What it does Think
Amazon Athena Serverless interactive queries on data in Amazon S3 with standard SQL; you pay for the queries you run SQL on S3 files
Amazon Redshift Fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse; a Serverless option exists Data warehouse
Amazon EMR Managed cluster platform for Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark big data processing Big data frameworks
Amazon OpenSearch Service Managed OpenSearch clusters for search, log analytics, application monitoring and clickstream analysis Search and logs

Exam tip: SQL on S3 with no servers: Athena. A data warehouse: Redshift. Search and logs: OpenSearch.

What the Exam Asks: AI/ML and Analytics

  • Text, speech, image, document or chat: Comprehend, Translate; Transcribe, Polly; Rekognition, Textract; Lex
  • Your own model: SageMaker AI
  • Streaming data: Kinesis Data Streams, or Firehose to deliver it
  • Prepare and catalog: AWS Glue
  • Query S3 with SQL: Athena; a warehouse: Redshift; Hadoop and Spark: EMR; search and logs: OpenSearch
  • Dashboards: Amazon Quick

Exam tip: Name the input or the stage, then the service.

Design Check: Tidewater's Data and AI Plan

Tidewater's need Choose
Sentiment in thousands of reviews Amazon Comprehend
Text from scanned supplier invoices Amazon Textract
Support call recordings turned into text Amazon Transcribe
Product photos checked for unsafe content Amazon Rekognition
A chatbot for order questions Amazon Lex
Train its own forecasting model Amazon SageMaker AI
Quick SQL answers from sales files in S3 Amazon Athena
Website clicks as a live stream Amazon Kinesis
Cleaning and cataloging the data AWS Glue
Dashboards for managers Amazon Quick
  • Cover the right column, answer each row yourself, then compare

3Exam Q&A

3.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer; some ask for two)

S1Tidewater wants to find out whether thousands of customer reviews are positive, neutral or negative. Which service fits best?

  • AAmazon Comprehend, which analyzes sentiment and key phrases in text
  • BAmazon Textract, which extracts text from scanned documents
  • CAmazon Polly, which turns text into spoken audio
  • DAmazon Transcribe, which converts speech into text
Show the answer

Answer: A. Comprehend uses natural language processing to find sentiment, entities, key phrases and more in text. Textract reads scanned documents, Polly produces speech from text, and Transcribe turns audio into text.

S2Which AWS service lets data scientists and developers build, train and deploy their own machine learning models?

  • AAmazon Lex, which builds conversational chatbots
  • BAmazon Rekognition, which analyzes images and video
  • CAmazon SageMaker AI, a fully managed machine learning service
  • DAmazon Translate, which translates text between languages
Show the answer

Answer: C. Amazon SageMaker AI is a fully managed machine learning service for building, training and deploying models. Lex, Rekognition and Translate are pre-built AI services that each perform a specific task.

S3Tidewater wants a chatbot on its website that understands what customers ask, by voice or text, and answers order questions. Which service should it use?

  • AAmazon Polly, which synthesizes lifelike speech
  • BAmazon Lex, which builds conversational interfaces
  • CAmazon Translate, which translates text
  • DAmazon Textract, which reads scanned forms
Show the answer

Answer: B. Amazon Lex builds voice and text chatbots with speech recognition and natural language understanding. Polly only speaks text, Translate converts languages, and Textract extracts data from documents.

S4The data team keeps sales files in Amazon S3 and wants to run standard SQL queries on them directly, without managing servers. Which service fits best?

  • AAmazon Redshift, with a data warehouse cluster sized in advance
  • BAmazon EMR, with a cluster running Hadoop and Spark
  • CAmazon OpenSearch Service, for search and log analytics
  • DAmazon Athena, a serverless query service for data in S3
Show the answer

Answer: D. Athena is a serverless service that runs standard SQL directly on data in S3, and you pay for the queries you run. Redshift is a data warehouse, EMR runs big data frameworks on clusters, and OpenSearch Service handles search and logs.

S5Which TWO statements about analytics services are correct? (Select TWO.)

  • AAWS Glue is an in-memory cache that sits in front of a database
  • BAmazon Kinesis Data Streams collects and processes streaming data records in real time
  • CAmazon Quick builds dashboards and interactive visualizations from your data
  • DAmazon Athena is a data warehouse whose capacity must be sized in advance
  • EAmazon Polly converts recorded speech into text
Show the answer

Answer: B, C. Kinesis Data Streams handles real-time streams, and Amazon Quick, which evolved from QuickSight, builds dashboards. Glue is a data integration service, Athena is serverless, and Polly turns text into speech rather than speech into text.

4Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
AI services Comprehend, Translate, Transcribe, Polly, Rekognition, Textract and Lex each do one task through an API
Your own models SageMaker AI; Bedrock offers foundation models; Amazon Q is an AI assistant
Collect and prepare Kinesis for streams, Firehose to deliver them, Glue to prepare and catalog
Analyze Athena for SQL on S3, Redshift for a warehouse, EMR for Hadoop and Spark, OpenSearch for search and logs
Visualize Amazon Quick, which evolved from QuickSight
